sources.identifier: Teresa Filshtein, powerepilab/Sim_for_data_pooling public HRS model export and methods, Git commit 6708e43d5e342fa76d57b31d5a6d0bfcc2979539
sources.population: HRS source sample summarized by the public export: 11,509 baseline participants; memory model uses 43,500 visits. Detailed inclusion/exclusion and missing-data selection are not specified in the admitted files.
sources.measurement: Age in years; age60 in decades centered at 60; sex Female/Male and race White/Black; education College/HS/LessThanHS; childhood SES in unspecified source scale; HbA1c in percent; mem.s in the source standardized memory scale. Exact instrument construction and clinical eligibility are not contained in these admitted artifacts.

sources.identifier: Published HRS Tables 2 and 3, DOI 10.1097/EDE.0000000000001373; coordinator-admitted numeric transcription
sources.population: The same HRS cohort represented in the public export; original 11,509 subjects and author-reported synthetic averages across 5,000 iterations. This is overlapping evidence, not another independent cohort.
sources.measurement: Baseline HRS variables and first-assessment memory; Table 3 longitudinal mixed-model terms. Original and synthetic summaries are rounded and not recomputed from participant records.

items.applicability: Used as a reported source-law parameter for synthetic reconstruction of this same published population. Not external validation, a causal effect, or an independent replicate study. Original method samples age/sex/race cells with replacement, then age uniformly in [50,55),[55,60),[60,65),[65,70),[70,75),[75,80),[80,100). Age60 is (age-60)/10. The broad last bin is a source-method approximation.

items.applicability: Used as a reported source-law parameter for synthetic reconstruction of this same published population. Not external validation, a causal effect, or an independent replicate study. Four evenly spaced visits two years apart; baseline covariates are retained across visits. Age60=(baseline age+visit time-60)/10; U65=min(HbA1c-6.5,0), O65=max(HbA1c-6.5,0). The unrelated age70 construction is not used by the HRS memory formula.

items.applicability: Used as a reported source-law parameter for synthetic reconstruction of this same published population. Not external validation, a causal effect, or an independent replicate study. Bivariate Gaussian subject random intercept and age60 slope; covariance=SD_intercept*SD_slope*correlation. Independent Gaussian errors for each visit, added to full mixed-model fixed predictor. No additional standardization of simulated mem.s.

items.selection: Same HRS source cohort and author-reported repeated synthetic reconstructions; exact HbA1c subgroup counts are unpublished.
items.applicability: Read after scientific law selection and used only to document limitations. The publication itself reports discrepancies in baseline age, HbA1c subgroup distributions, education and baseline memory despite near agreement of many fitted effects. Rounded synthetic summaries are not calibration targets; no coefficients or distributions were changed after reading them. The high-precision original export remains the numerical parameter source.
